title: SQLite busy retry
body: Retry SQLITE_BUSY writes with a bounded backoff after a concurrent writer releases the lock.

title: Node runtime floor
body: The package requires Node.js 24.16.0 or newer for the built-in SQLite APIs.

title: FTS external content repair
body: Use the FTS5 rebuild command after an external-content integrity check reports a mismatch.

title: Immutable migrations
body: Never edit the initial migration after release because its recorded checksum must remain stable.

title: Embedding provider timeout
body: Abort a slow embedding request at the configured deadline and retry only bounded transport failures.

title: Pre-inference secret scan
body: Reject credential-shaped memory text before sending any embedding document to the local provider.

title: Known sqlite-vec loader
body: Load only the package-owned sqlite-vec extension and disable extension loading immediately afterward.

title: Query vector cache
body: Cache query embeddings by normalized query hash and active profile without persisting raw query text.

title: Embedding job leases
body: Atomically reclaim an expired embedding job lease so two workers never finalize the same claim.

title: Deterministic delivery replay
body: Bind context delivery identity to policy, query vector, backend, and semantic projection state.

title: 日本語検索の整合性
body: 日本語の語彙検索では unicode61 と trigram の経路を分離し、検索順位を安定させる。

title: Atomic local profile switch
body: Activate the local embedding profile only through an explicit replacement transaction that increments generation.

title: React state isolation
body: Keep component state local and avoid mutating caller-owned props during a render.

title: Rust borrow lifetime
body: Shorten a mutable borrow before taking another reference to the same collection.

title: Visible keyboard focus
body: Interactive controls need a visible focus indicator that is not conveyed by color alone.

title: Idempotency conflict
body: Return the stored response for an exact retry and reject changed input under the same idempotency key.

title: Global credential redaction
body: Never persist authentication tokens, cookies, private keys, or authorization headers in reusable memory.

title: Verification before completion
body: Run the focused reproduction and the broader project gate before claiming an implementation is complete.

title: PostgreSQL lock inspection
body: Inspect pg_locks and pg_stat_activity before assigning a deadlock cause to an application query.

title: Svelte keyed list
body: Use a stable keyed each block when list items can be reordered without recreating component state.

title: Old vector payload
body: This revision is replaced after its vector is written.

title: Superseded vector payload
body: This entry is superseded and must never be returned.
